step_by_step_reasoning: The architecture diagram features an external Mobile app user/device interacting with two Application Load Balancers (ALBs) inside an AWS VPC. One ALB handles incoming play selections/REST API requests and notifications to the mobile app, while the second ALB handles incoming fan votes. Both ALBs route traffic into Amazon EKS running microservices. EKS interacts asynchronously with SQS (writing to and reading from queues for scoring/gaming logic). EKS also connects to Amazon ElastiCache for session caching and Amazon Aurora for persistent database storage.
